Both she and the boy lean in with extremely exaggerated expressions of surprise, their mouths wide open. Red variety-style text boxes labeled 'Gasp' appear on the screen to emphasize their shock. (3) Transition to a scene where the boy is writing on a white desk with several colorful pens. Several red circular text bubbles pop up around him, and large stylized captions saying 'Super Unbeatable' are displayed at the bottom of the frame to highlight the quality. (4) The woman presents a white notebook with 'Campus' branding. The boy reacts with a look of disbelief. A picture-in-picture circle shows the boy's face as he talks about the 2025 notebook. Flaming visual effects appear on the screen during the eraser segment.
